entity.description: The service validator checks an event id, version 1, and a place with id, name, latitude, and longitude. A weather.forecast-updated event must carry a forecast with updatedAt, fetchedAt, mode, and one to six periods; each period is checked for a timestamp, numeric temperature, null or nonnegative numeric precipitation, and a string symbol. The weather_cards upsert stores place fields, updated_at, and the forecast JSON. The inbox table is used for event-id duplicate handling, while rejected_messages records topic, partition, offset, and reason. summary.text: Dashboard source parses message.value and validates the event before calling applyEvent. Parse or validation errors are caught, recorded in rejected_messages with reason INVALID_EVENT, followed by an offset-plus-one commit and return. applyEvent records event.id in inbox; duplicates commit and return without a card write. Otherwise it upserts weather_cards: forecast updates store place fields and forecast JSON, updating an existing card only when stored updated_at is null or the incoming value is later; the other branch writes place fields only. The transaction commits on success and rolls back and rethrows on error. The supplied source does not identify a configured or resolved database destination.
